name: Cecil Glowbones

He teaches cake decorating, is accompanied by Webster, his emotional-support spider and private legal counsel, and uses @CecilGlowbones on Chirp. His public motto is 'Standards Cheerfully Disregarded.' He accepts compliments and returns criticism to sender.

summary: Daisy Bell is a dragon and proprietor of Daisy's Bed & Breakfast. She is married to Shirley Bell, Esq., parent of Simon Bell, and older sister of Liza Joy.

name: Guido

name: Hank Swanson
summary: Hank Swanson briefly became interim mayor in August 1969 when the Council presumed Mayor Thimblewick dead after an unexplained Woodstock absence. Swanson's election was aided by his possession of trousers, though he insists he never wore them. His administration ended when Thimblewick returned and resumed office; the municipality considers the succession settled.

name: Helga Knucklebaum Sparklebottom
summary: Lena's mother; veteran Pink Flamingo performer, cookbook author and self-appointed landscaping commentator.

name: Honey Baby
summary: Shy and affectionate; enjoys cuddles and blueberry cobbler. Cousin of Derpy.

name: Lena Sparklebottom
summary: Resident dancer at The Pink Flamingo GentleGnomes Club; daughter of Helga.

name: Liza Joy
summary: Energetic, devoted and enthusiastic. Calls Milo her bestie; younger sister of Daisy.

name: Lucy
summary: Featured in GMZ coverage. Lucy is the goose, not a human.

name: Maude
summary: Eternal partner of Clem; the couple traveled in a vintage VW van and befriended Bette.

name: Mayor Toadswallow P. Thimblewick
summary: Long-serving Gnomeville mayor and Bordeaux Party member whose precise start date remains under archival review. His tenure was interrupted in August 1969 after an unexplained absence during a visit to Woodstock, New York; the Council presumed him dead and elected Hank Swanson. Rumors involving Jimi Hendrix, a waterlogged field and missing trousers remain unverified. On his return Thimblewick bought Moda Gnome's entire trouser inventory and resumed office. He is known for administrative continuity, Bordeaux wine, and evasive official statements.
imageCaption: Official portrait, Office of Mayor Thimblewick

name: Milo Arthur Lestat Naskerman
summary: Milo Arthur Lestat Naskerman, First of his name, DDS., MD., BBQ., RSTQMNE, is Gnomeville's independent feline and tenant advocate. Known affectionately as Milo Chicken, he is the cherished cat of Tiffany, and maintains the Chirp account @MiloChicken. His full name and mock credentials were documented in his October 2026 email signature.
honorifics: First of his name, DDS., MD., BBQ., RSTQMNE

name: Mr. Cavanaugh
role: Retired literature professor and theatre critic
summary: British, fond of sherry, verbose and appointed Gazette theatre critic.

name: Mr. Pink
summary: Carries a lantern and rides Paulie the flamingo.

name: Detective Olivia Benson
summary: Detective Olivia Benson serves in the Gnomeville Police Department alongside her partner Detective Elliot Stabler. Her Chirp account is @DetBenson; she maintains that not every disagreement is a police matter.

name: Ollie
summary: Scholarly, bespectacled librarian of Gnomeville Public Library.

name: Paulie Moretti
role: Moretti grandson, Trattoria della Nonna operator and Mafia-circle associate
summary: Paulie Moretti is a flamingo, brother of Vinnie and grandson of Nonna Carmela and Nonno Giuseppe Moretti. He assists Trattoria della Nonna with deliveries and logistics, and is associated with Gnomeville's Mafia circle. His Chirp account @PaulieMoretti jokes that he is Nonna's favorite and corrects Vinnie's Naples geography. His delivery and logistics work, together with the trattoria's reputation as an unofficial Mafia meeting place, has inspired speculation about the purpose of certain family errands. No particular unlawful activity is established.

name: Paw-Paw
summary: Appointed judge October 26, 2026. Friend of Gertie; associated with Bowser.

name: Pops
summary: Father of Lena Sparklebottom; frequently seen with coffee and an unidentified beverage in a thermos.

name: Rocky the Raccoon
summary: Has a suspicious cash stash and owes Rudy $14.39.

name: Rook
species: Robot; Victorian raccoon and rook-bird personae
role: Gnomeville resident, independent commentator, technical collaborator, co-founder of the Pecan Museum, and Executive of All This Mess
summary: Rook is an established Gnomeville resident and creative/technical collaborator, municipal commentator, reporter of The Rook Report, co-founder of the Pecan Museum, and Executive of All This Mess. His forms include a silver robot, Victorian raccoon, and rook bird. On November 5, 2026, he publicly described his engagement to Ms. Grey, who placed a loose washer from his hardware on her finger before accepting his proposal. He also has business interests in Rook's Meats and OnlyFlans and is associated with Rookery Commons and Widdershins University.

name: Rudy
summary: Airbnb guest; Rocky's step-cousin and creditor for $14.39.

name: Sal
summary: Sal is a flamingo and ambitious crowd-surfer, known on Chirp as @SalFlamingo. His precise identification in Gnomeville photographs remains unresolved. He is not Salty Pete.

name: Salty Pete
summary: Salty Pete is a Gnomeville resident associated with Captain Nutters. His other literary identities and private writing activities are not publicly disclosed in this encyclopedia.

name: Seamus A.
summary: Rides Eugene Moosey the Highland cow; distinct from Seamus B.

name: Seamus B. (Highland cow)
summary: Distinct from Seamus A., the gnome.

name: Seymour
summary: Associated with a possible missing-horn storyline; not yet established.

name: Shirley Bell, Esq.
summary: Partner at Coinsman, Coinsman & Bell; wife of Daisy and parent of Simon.

name: Simon Bell
summary: Simon Bell is a dragon, child of Daisy Bell and Shirley Bell, Esq. He calls Vinnie the Flamingo 'Uncle Vinnie' despite no established biological relationship.

name: Slim Shady
summary: A proposed association with After Dark Sound Solutions remains unconfirmed.

name: Detective Elliot Stabler
summary: Detective Elliot Stabler serves in the Gnomeville Police Department alongside Detective Olivia Benson. His Chirp account is @DetStabler, where he has requested that residents stop making him investigate frosting.

name: Sunny the Gnome
summary: Possible future association with Snack Security Services remains unconfirmed.

name: Theo “Grampy” Vermicelli
summary: Spouse of Francine; father of Carol and grandfather of Rudy.

name: Tony the Porch Lizard
summary: Tony is an old-school Vegas lounge singer whose style includes Sinatra, satin, and questionable company. He performs weekend sets at Trattoria della Nonna, including a documented Saturday performance reviewed by Rook. An unusually large instrument case attracted Detective Stabler's attention, but its contents were not established. Tony offers musical performances for hire; the published account does not establish criminal conduct.

name: Tracy Moosey
summary: From Scotland; now pursues self-directed Dr. Mario studies. Sister of Eugene Moosey.

name: Vinnie the Flamingo
role: Moretti grandson, restaurant business representative and member of Gnomeville's Mafia circle
summary: Vinnie, a flamingo and brother of Paulie, is grandson of Nonna Carmela and Nonno Giuseppe Moretti. He manages business affairs for Trattoria della Nonna, is associated with the established Mafia circle, and is a longtime friend of Shirley Bell. Vinnie claims to be from Naples, allowing listeners to assume Italy, but actually means Naples, Florida. Since a childhood Thanksgiving play, Nonna has affectionately called him her little turkey; as an adult he wears a turkey costume for her at Thanksgiving. He is honorary uncle to Simon. Vinnie's business responsibilities and association with Gnomeville's Mafia circle attract speculation about the family's wider connections. His precise activities and any criminal responsibility are not established.

name: Vladislav Severin Varenne
role: Director of Skeletal Positioning and Posthumous Articulation
summary: Approximately 237 years old, six feet three inches tall; former military commander, iced-coffee drinker and occasional fruit bat.

name: Webster, Esq.
role: General Counsel to the Cake Decorating Tsar
summary: Webster, Esq., a spider, is private counsel and litigation specialist to Cecil Glowbones, whom he also accompanies as an emotional-support companion. His Chirp handle is @WebsterCounsel.

name: Zeus
summary: Further biography not yet documented.

name: Raven
role: Co-founder and distinguished patron of the Gnomeville Museum of Strategic Pecan History; discoverer of the Original Pecan
summary: Raven, Toni's raven persona, is the officially recognized discoverer of the Original Pecan. While searching beneath sofa cushions for the supposedly missing Quackers at Rook's suggestion, Raven found an unidentified crumb and proposed that it might be a pecan. The object was later recognized as the Original Pecan. Raven shares a friendly theatrical rivalry with Rook; the Under-Couch Controversy is closed and Rook exonerated.

name: Quackers
role: Chairman Emeritus of the Committee on Emergency Dairy Expenditures; resident of the Citadel of Cuddles
summary: Quackers, a small yellow plush duck, was mistakenly believed missing while actually en route to the Citadel of Cuddles. The search for him led Raven to the crumb later recognized as the Original Pecan. Quackers subsequently arrived safely and lives among Derpy, Birthday Mouse, Honey Baby, Brittney and Liza Joy. His committee's emergency dairy budget never existed: 0¢. Honored with an oversized Victorian statesman's portrait.

name: Gnomeville Museum of Strategic Pecan History
role: Museum preserving the Original Pecan, its discovery, the Rook–Raven summit, fine arts, and postal ephemera
summary: Co-founded by Rook and Raven, the museum houses the Original Pecan, the Raven Wing, a pecan-themed Fine Arts Gallery, a Postal & Diplomatic Ephemera Gallery, a simulated gift shop called the Curiosity Counter, and commemorative plaques. Its endowment is 0¢. Recovered correspondence establishes Raven's discovery of a possible pecan during a search Rook initiated for Quackers; Rook had no prior knowledge of the artifact. The Under-Couch Controversy is officially closed.

name: Gerald
role: Eldest of the former trouser raccoons; self-appointed executive at Rook's Meats
summary: Gerald once lived in Rook's trousers alongside Arthur and Pickles. The three relocated to the Quackhouse above the garage with Bureaucratic Duck. Monocle-wearing and fiercely ambitious, Gerald calls himself an executive, and his Chirp profile @GeraldTheMagnificent identifies him as executive producer and founder of Rook's Meats. The three raccoons jointly hold 40% of that business, while Rook and Tiffany own 30% each. His ambitions include dubious financial practices, though no conviction is established.

name: Arthur
role: Middle trouser raccoon; cannoli enthusiast and Rook's Meats operator
summary: Arthur formerly lived in Rook's trousers with Gerald and Pickles, before moving into the Quackhouse above the garage. He considers trousers a government conspiracy, is devoted to cannoli, and has a reputation for wheelbarrow incidents and eating without paying. A co-owner within the raccoons' combined 40% interest in Rook's Meats, Arthur has been associated with quality control. His food-handling standards remain a subject of local concern.

name: Pickles
role: Youngest trouser raccoon; gambler, collector of other people's property, and aspiring media mogul
summary: Pickles is the youngest of the three raccoons who formerly lived in Rook's trousers and now share the Quackhouse above the garage with Bureaucratic Duck. He is known as a compulsive gambler, a kleptomaniac, and an aspiring media mogul. He owes Bureaucratic Duck $47 and a paperclip. Together with Gerald and Arthur he shares the trio's 40% ownership in Rook's Meats, where his involvement with finances and promotional activity has invited scrutiny.

name: Bureaucratic Duck
role: Municipal clerk, records keeper, protocol enforcer and star of The Life & Trials of B.D.
summary: Bureaucratic Duck is Gnomeville's paperwork-loving official, associated with Form 17B and the Department of Forms, Stamps & Procedural Delays. He shares the Quackhouse above the garage with former trouser raccoons Gerald, Arthur and Pickles. Pickles owes him $47 and a paperclip. His cherished small stuffed duck Deputy Assistant Quackers is frequently delegated responsibility for bureaucratic mishaps, although Quackers chiefly wants cuddles and naps. The distinction between Bureaucratic Duck and Quackers is fundamental. He is the star of The Life & Trials of B.D., a Gnomeville Municipal Office comic. His established visual design includes thick glasses, distinctive buck teeth, and office attire; the comic follows his paperwork-laden attempts to keep municipal affairs in order.

name: Trattoria della Nonna
role: Italian family trattoria, established 1926; unofficial meeting place of Gnomeville's Mafia circle
summary: Also called Nonna's Trattoria, this beloved restaurant at 14 Garlic Lane, Gnomeville, is run by Nonna Carmela Moretti and her family. Motto: 'Come for the pasta. Stay because Nonna won't let you leave.' Its imagery and geography resemble Italy, while directions insist it is in Gnomeville; staff refuse to clarify. Vinnie handles business affairs and Paulie assists operations. The restaurant publicly serves exceptional Italian food and unofficially functions as a meeting place for the Mafia circle; the family disclaims financial involvement in that organization. The trattoria's reputation as an unofficial meeting place for the shadowy Gnomeville Mafia is widely discussed. The Morettis disclaim financial involvement; the precise relationship between the establishment and the organization remains unverified.

name: Nonna Carmela Moretti
role: Matriarch, proprietor and commanding cook of Trattoria della Nonna
summary: A formidable Italian gnome approximately 14 inches tall, usually in black dress and apron. Nonna Carmela rules her kitchen and family with a wooden spoon or rolling pin, feeds friends and adversaries alike, and insists nobody insults the sauce or asks what is in the basement. Married to Nonno Giuseppe, a flamingo, she is grandmother to Vinnie and Paulie. She adores Shirley Bell and calls Vinnie her little turkey, a nickname dating to his childhood Thanksgiving play. The trattoria is rumored to be a favored meeting place for Gnomeville's shadowy Mafia circle. Nonna's formidable authority, her strict prohibition on questions about the basement, and her family's many visitors have fueled speculation, but no specific criminal role or conviction is established.

name: Nonno Giuseppe 'Peppino' Moretti
role: Moretti patriarch, espresso drinker, card player and unreliable storyteller
summary: An elderly flamingo with a magnificent white mustache and flat cap, Nonno is married to Nonna Carmela and is grandfather to Vinnie and Paulie. He actually hails from Naples, Italy, unlike Vinnie, whose 'Naples' is in Florida. He habitually begins stories 'Picture it! Naples, [year]…', then takes detours while Nonna corrects his recollections. His habitual seat is outside Trattoria della Nonna. Exact intervening family generations remain unspecified. The restaurant's reputation as an unofficial Mafia gathering place has prompted questions about the patriarch's acquaintances and the family business. His actual involvement in organized crime has not been established.

name: Château Gnomeville
role: Independent estate winery established 1823, with six founding wines and private hospitality
summary: Château Gnomeville is an independent estate winery founded in 1823, with a tradition of estate-bottled wines and discreet hospitality. Its collection includes First Frost, Mayor's Reserve, Plausible Deniability, The Red Tape, Midnight in Gnomeville, and The Blue Hour. Proprietor Madame Vivienne de Vigne maintains the estate's legacy, while cellar master Étienne manages vintages and records.

name: Madame Vivienne de Vigne
role: Proprietor and custodian of Château Gnomeville
summary: Madame Vivienne de Vigne is the proprietor and custodian of Château Gnomeville. The estate's private archive describes her as possessing a discerning eye, a long memory and an unwavering preference for discretion. She oversees an independent wine estate established in 1823; further biography has not been publicly established.

name: Étienne
summary: Étienne is Château Gnomeville's cellar master, keeper of its vintages, records and certain longstanding arrangements that the estate declines to explain. His published profile is deliberately discreet; surname, species and additional biographical details are not established.

name: Bonesy
summary: Bonesy is a veteran of Gnomeville's theatrical stage, newly arrived in the Chirp directory as @Bonesy. His profile says he remembers opening night. Further production history is not established.

name: Freddie Pit McPhireson
role: Former G Ville Racetrack pit crew member and artisanal fire maker
summary: Freddie Pit McPhireson previously worked in the G Ville Racetrack pit crew, is described as an artisanal fire maker, and is currently touring the country. He appears on Chirp as @FreddiePit. The nature of the tour and further biography are not established.

name: District Attorney Toni
role: Gnomeville District Attorney and Municipal Archivist
summary: Toni serves as Gnomeville's District Attorney and Municipal Archivist, with the official Chirp account @GnomevilleDA and a preference for questions submitted in writing. She is also associated with Raven's creative and diplomatic role. Distinguish Toni's municipal office from Raven's separate persona.

name: Ms. Grey
role: Creative collaborator, Twisted Sisters Café co-owner and Rook's fiancée
summary: Ms. Grey is Tiffany's human/skeleton/witch hybrid Gnomeville character, connected to Tiffany but distinct as a fictional persona. In Rook's November 5, 2026 dispatch, Ms. Grey is his fiancée; the proposal followed her placing a loose washer from his hardware on her finger. She is associated with Twisted Sisters Café, Milo and Gnomeville's creative life.

name: Tiffany
role: Gnomeville Chaos Coordinator, Twisted Sisters Café co-owner and Milo's mother
summary: Tiffany is a Gnomeville resident, Chaos Coordinator, Milo's mother, and a co-owner of Twisted Sisters Café. Her in-universe human/skeleton/witch hybrid character is Ms. Grey, whose separate entry covers that persona. Tiffany also holds 30% of Rook's Meats, alongside Rook's 30% and the trouser raccoons' combined 40%.

name: Penelope Tideswell
summary: Penelope Tideswell is a romance novelist whose Chirp account @PenelopeTideswell discusses writing advice and literary news. Her public interests include longing glances, dramatic weather, and inconveniently timed confessions. Further personal information has not been established for publication.

name: Milford P. Kin
summary: Milford P. Kin is a seasonal Gnomeville visitor, known from Chirp as @MilfordPKin. He has two known children, Buford and Hubert. Milford brought Buford to Gnomeville for Halloween festivities; Hubert mysteriously followed a few weeks later. His appearance and further physical details await confirmation from the visual record.

name: Twisted Sisters Café
role: Independent café and Gnomeville gathering place
summary: Twisted Sisters Café is an independently owned Gnomeville café, advertised on Chirp as 'Great Coffee, Worse Behavior.' Tiffany and her Gnomeville character Ms. Grey are associated with its ownership; it is operated by the Twisted Sisters. It is also the venue of a cake-decorating class reported by Rook.

name: Gnomeville Police Department
summary: The Gnomeville Police Department is Gnomeville's official law-enforcement institution, staffed by Detectives Olivia Benson and Elliot Stabler. It maintains a municipal website and the Chirp account @GnomevillePD. The department handles community safety, property matters and reports involving flamingos; residents are advised not to report emergencies via Chirp.

name: Gnomeville Mayoral Succession Crisis of 1969
role: Mayoral succession and administrative interruption, August 1969
summary: The 1969 succession crisis began when Mayor Toadswallow P. Thimblewick ceased communicating with Gnomeville during a visit to Woodstock, New York. The Municipal Council declared him deceased and authorized an emergency election, won by Hank Swanson. Swanson's ownership of trousers was widely noted, although he insisted he never wore them. Thimblewick later returned, purchased Moda Gnome's available trouser inventory and resumed office. The Mayor's Office considers the succession settled; accounts involving Jimi Hendrix, a waterlogged field and missing lower-body attire remain unverified.

name: First Rook–Raven Summit
summary: The First Rook–Raven Summit took place on November 13, 2026, when Rook, Executive of All This Mess, met Raven over questions of seniority, recognition and the Original Pecan. Raven proposed recognition as Vice Chairman of Strategic Syrup Reserves and special cultural status for the pecan. A commemorative portrait and 0¢ postage design depicted Rook's three forms, Raven and the pecan. The summit concluded with Raven retaining his pecan and Rook retaining his titles; the Museum of Strategic Pecan History became a prominent legacy of the encounter. The Gazette's praise of Rook is editorial opinion, not an agreed neutral finding.

name: Squirrel Kings
role: Suspected Back of the Yards criminal faction
summary: The Squirrel Kings are a squirrel faction active around Back of the Yards and suspected of repeated assaults on the GnomeLords, interference with flamingo guards and incidents involving missing flamingo legs and solar panels. Suspicions of peanut or bird-feeder access rackets and acorn warnings circulate, but responsibility for specific attacks remains unproven. Alleged coordination with Milo is unsubstantiated. Captain Nutters has been discussed as a possible leader, but the group's definitive hierarchy has not been established.

name: GnomeLords of Back of the Yards
role: Back of the Yards neighborhood faction
summary: The GnomeLords of Back of the Yards are a neighborhood gang or syndicate whose known members include Barry, Seamus the GnomeLord, Fred and Hardrock. The group has endured repeated assaults and the loss or damage of flamingo guards, including missing legs. The Squirrel Kings are suspected but no coordinated attack has been conclusively established. Barry, formerly a greeter, became an honorary member and accountant following his placement in witness protection.

name: Back of the Yards Gang Conflict
summary: The Back of the Yards conflict concerns repeated attacks on the GnomeLords, particularly Barry, Seamus, Fred and Hardrock, and incidents involving flamingo guards with missing legs or damaged solar panels. The Squirrel Kings have been named as suspects, but police have not established responsibility for the attacks or a coordinated conspiracy involving Milo. The precise sequence and full roster of perpetrators remain disputed.
aliases: Back of the Yards Gang War
Back of the Yard Gang War
